headline: Transition Benefits, Peer Camaraderie & Legacy Mentorship
summary: Trusted guidance covering veteran healthcare, education benefits, civilian career translation, and peer support networks.

advice.title: Keep Benefits & Service Records Centralized
advice.guidance: Maintain verified digital copies of DD-214, healthcare enrollment, and annual benefit review dates in one checklist.
advice.actionStep: Confirm your annual VA healthcare and benefit renewal reminders.

advice.title: Translate Service Leadership for Civilian Teams
advice.guidance: Convert military occupational specialties into measurable logistics, operations, safety, and team-leadership outcomes.
advice.actionStep: Highlight two quantifiable mission-readiness results on your profile.

advice.title: Stay Connected Through Peer Mentorship
advice.guidance: Weekly check-ins with local veteran chapters or mentoring younger students strengthens resilience and purpose.
advice.actionStep: Reach out to one peer mentor or community chapter this week.

links.title: VA.gov Benefits, Healthcare & GI Bill

links.title: Veterans Crisis Line (988 then Press 1)
links.description: Confidential 24/7 support via call, chat, or text for veterans, service members, and families.

links.title: SBA Veteran Entrepreneur Programs (VBOC)
links.description: Boots to Business training, veteran-owned certification, and capital access.
